title: Apache Spark using Databricks
overview: This course provides an in-depth understanding of Apache Spark and its implementation within Databricks, a cloud-based platform for big data analytics and AI workloads. Participants will learn Spark's architecture, DataFrames, SQL, structured streaming, machine learning with MLlib, and performance optimizations while leveraging Databricks' collaborative and scalable environment. Hands-on labs will enable participants to efficiently build data processing pipelines, optimize Spark jobs, and deploy scalable applications.
audience: Data Engineers looking to build scalable data pipelines
Data Scientists using Spark for large-scale ML workloads
Big Data Analysts working with large datasets
Cloud Engineers handling distributed computing and data processing
Software Developers integrating Spark into enterprise applications
Business Intelligence Professionals leveraging Spark for analytics
methodology: Hands-on Labs – Running Apache Spark on Databricks Notebooks
Live Demonstrations – Implementing real-world big data workflows
Use Case Studies – Applying Spark & Databricks in business scenarios
Collaborative Learning – Group discussions and problem-solving sessions
Capstone Project – Developing an end-to-end data pipeline in Databricks
competencies: Data Processing with Spark RDDs, DataFrames & SQL
Distributed Computing and Cluster Optimization in Databricks
Building Machine Learning Models with Spark MLlib
Real-Time Data Processing using Spark Streaming
objectivesIntro: By the end of the course, participants will be able to:
objectives: Understand Apache Spark’s core architecture and execution model
Work with Databricks Notebooks for interactive data analysis
Implement PySpark & Scala-based transformations and aggregations
Use Spark SQL for large-scale structured data processing
Optimize Spark Jobs for performance & scalability in Databricks
Deploy machine learning models using Spark MLlib
Handle real-time streaming data with Structured Streaming
Develop production-grade Spark applications in Databricks

outline.title: Module 1: Introduction to Apache Spark & Databricks

items.text: Overview of Big Data, Apache Spark & Distributed Computing
What is Databricks? – Features, Architecture, and Use Cases
Setting up a Databricks Workspace & Cluster
Navigating Databricks Notebooks and Collaborative Workflows
PySpark vs Scala – Choosing the Right Language for Spark
Understanding Spark Architecture & Execution Model

Transformations & Actions – How Spark Processes Data
Data Partitioning & Parallel Processing in Spark
Fault Tolerance & Lazy Evaluation in Spark

outline.title: Module 3: Working with DataFrames and Spark SQL

items.text: Introduction to DataFrames – Schema & Data Loading
Performing Data Manipulation & Transformation

Optimizing SQL Queries using Catalyst Optimizer

outline.title: Module 4: Advanced Data Engineering with Apache Spark

items.text: ETL Pipelines in Databricks – Data Extraction, Transformation, and Loading
Partitioning, Bucketing & Caching Strategies for Performance
Handling JSON, Parquet, CSV, and Avro File Formats
Integration with Cloud Storage (AWS S3, Azure Blob, Google Cloud Storage)

outline.title: Module 5: Machine Learning with Spark MLlib

items.text: Overview of MLlib and Distributed Machine Learning
Feature Engineering & Data Preprocessing in Spark
Training & Evaluating ML Models in Databricks

outline.title: Module 7: Performance Optimization & Debugging in Spark

items.text: Understanding the Spark UI & Execution Plan

Performance Tuning in Databricks – Cluster Autoscaling & Caching Strategies

outline.title: Module 8: Integrating Databricks with Cloud & Enterprise Applications

items.text: Connecting Spark to Relational Databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQL Server)
Reading/Writing Data to MongoDB, Cassandra, Elasticsearch
Integrating Databricks with Apache Airflow for Workflow Automation
Deploying Spark Workloads on AWS EMR, Azure Databricks, GCP Dataproc

outline.title: Module 9: Real-World Use Cases & Case Studies

items.text: ETL Workflows for Data Warehousing with Apache Spark
Customer Segmentation using Spark MLlib
Real-Time Analytics for Financial Data Processing
Scaling Data Science Workflows in Databricks
